_what: THE PLAN OF RECORD for reaching client-deliverable work. One file, machine-read. Consumed by pipeline/scripts/plan_status.py, which is run at the top of every session and after every commit that closes work.
_why_this_file_exists: Session 2026-08-09 measured the same defect three times over: 357 critic items filed / ~22 built; ~61 DR units / 39 write-only; 21 gate artifacts / 2 with a verdict. Every one of them is a queue whose consumer never visits it. A plan written as prose in a markdown file would be the fourth instance. So the plan is DATA, its consumer is a script, and the script prints WHERE WE ARE and WHAT IS NEXT without being asked.
_law: A phase closes only when its exit_test is RUN and its result recorded here. 'Done' with no recorded run is not done.
Every close triggers a REVIEW that must return a verdict per remaining phase: keep / change / drop — with a reason. A review that changes nothing must SAY it changed nothing and why.
The plan may be wrong. Dropping a phase with a recorded reason is a correct outcome, not a failure.
No phase may be marked done because its work was performed. It is done when the test that could have failed did not.
goal: One frame of the owner's own client bedroom (PRJ-2026-002 master suite) that three independent sighted judges rank as sendable when shuffled blind among four of the friend's delivered renders — and that the owner, looking at it, does not call unfinished.
benchmark: _private/ delivered anchor pool (658 renders). Never leaves this machine, never enters git.

cap._note: self-bound by the builder, tighter than TRN-001's 20/37. Only the owner may raise it.

standing_corrections.claim: The corpus was never read as a corpus. 658 images given, 1 used 38 times; the other 657 built 8 RANK sheets that were answered 0 times.

standing_corrections.claim: 9 of 11 rule families in CLAUDE.md originate in a sentence the owner said while looking at an image. 2 are the builder's, both corollaries written after his order. 0 came from a critic agent unprompted. The owner's eye is the most productive sensor in this project and he discounts it.
standing_corrections.do: Optimise for DISTINCT frames reaching his eye per day, not for one frame's perfection. 46 frames of the same room is a starved sensor. Never replace his verdict with an AI panel; the panel screens, he decides.

standing_corrections.claim: He does not have 'only images' — he has the author. One question to the designer friend beat a 154-line DR (3D Warehouse, absent from that DR entirely). The whole project has asked him one question.
standing_corrections.do: TWO questions, not five — three were withdrawn once SC-5 was found. Withdrawn: light count/HDRI/IES (measured in the ground-truth study), resolution/time/machine (median 4.19 MP is measured from the 658-pool; the rest is findable and not load-bearing), hours per frame (the internet gives a usable range). SURVIVING: (1) which pieces does he MODEL rather than buy — the general half is findable but our own 154-line DR missed 3D Warehouse entirely while he named it in one sentence; (2) what do Thai residential clients send back most often — not on the internet, specific to his market and his practice.
standing_corrections._why_the_other_three_went: Asking a busy person a question you have already measured is how you stop getting answers.

standing_corrections.claim: DR already helped and the plan did not read it. The 2026-08-08 craft/CG-tells unit carries a verified controlled experiment (Rademacher et al., EGRW 2001, n=18) that RERANKS this plan: surface roughness beats shadow softness as a realism cue (R .71 vs .39, p=.0003); shadow softening is flat above 5.21 deg and our area lights are already tens of degrees; more light SOURCES is not significant; more OBJECTS is not significant. Our texture-map coverage is 4.9% against 50-66% in delivered .blend files.
standing_corrections.do: Texture/material work outranks light work and outranks styling density. Styling density stays, but justified as COMPLETENESS, never as realism. A new DR fires only when the phase and the code file that will consume it are named in the same commit.

standing_corrections.claim: The fourth instance of the same defect, found while answering 'can't you just look it up': blender-ground-truth-study-2026-07-30.md opened five real production .blend files and measured the answer to three of the five questions drafted for the designer friend — light count, IES, HDRI strength, aperture, texture share, fabric maps, cloth poly counts, modifier usage, sample counts. It has been on disk since 30 July with zero consumers. It is a better answer than the internet can give and better than asking, because it is what practitioners DID rather than what they say they do.
standing_corrections.do: P2 and P3 take their targets from that table, not from priors: texture share 5% -> 50-66%; fabric 0 maps -> 3-8 with sheen <=0.4 (we currently compensate missing maps with 2x the max pro sheen); SUBSURF on soft forms and stop bevelling 81% of everything; f/9.0 -> f/2.0; light range 10:1 -> aim past 191:1. Samples are NOT a lever — 256 is already inside the pro band. And the exposure sign: the same-genre file grades UP a strong rig (+1.116) while we grade DOWN a weak one (-0.1).

phases.title: Light RANGE, not light count
phases.goal: p1 luminance from 51 toward the target's 13. This is occlusion and exposure, not more lamps.
phases._evidence: SC-4: more light sources is not significant for perceived realism, and shadow softening is flat above 5.21 deg while our area lights are already tens of degrees wide. Twelve gates ranked 'flat light' #1-2 and the obvious fix — add lamps, soften them — is measured to buy nothing. The defect is range.

phases.exit_test: TERMINAL CONDITION IS THE OWNER: he looks at the frame and does not call it unfinished. The blind panel is the SCREEN that must clear first — across three draws our cell never ranks last and no reason written against it names a defect — and clearing it is what earns the right to show him, never a substitute for showing him. Found by the first review: the original exit test described only the panel and left his look as a trailing sentence, which is the same defect as a finish line whose three conditions never open the picture.

trn002.recommendation: Close as a unit at r39. Spend ONE round on the one free, accepted, unshipped item: merge the beauty.soft block bracketed and written up as ACCEPT at gate-16 on 2026-08-07 and never merged (beauty is null in all 10 specs r28-r38, so _soften is dead code in every shipping frame). Record 2 rounds and 7 frames as UNSPENT, not transferred.
trn002.why_not_the_earlier_reason: TWO reasons were withdrawn, not one. (1) The first draft closed it because the target is 0.89 MP and therefore unsendable — that answers the wrong question; the target was never the deliverable, it is the teacher, and judging a teacher by whether you can sell the homework is a category error. (2) The second draft said the learning rate had reached zero. CHECKED, AND IT IS NOT TRUE: rounds 35-38 produced contact_check.py, a working instrument, and r37 taught that deleting a mass deletes its material rule with it — a rate comparable to TRN-001's. That sentence was written to make the conclusion sound heavier than the evidence, which is the failure mode this plan exists to catch.
trn002.standing_order_intact: qa/reproduction-curriculum.md's one-reproduction-per-session order is NOT cancelled. TRN-003 opens when the deliverable frame ships, with a cap declared BEFORE round 1 — which R1 has never once had.
trn002.the_real_reason: Every remaining gap in that frame is a BUILDER CAPABILITY, not a measurement: SUBSURF 0 against pros who subdivide soft forms, 5% of materials textured against 50-66%, 0 image maps on any fabric against 3-8, pillows at 156 polys against 3,124-88,374, f/9.0 against f/1.4-2.4, a 10:1 light range against ~2500:1, IES 0/30 against 4/5 point lights in the same-genre file. All measured in projects/PRJ-2026-002_c001-house/04_visualization/blender-ground-truth-study-2026-07-30.md. trn002_build.py has 7 generators, no mesh importer and 8 shader channels, so it cannot close any of them. Four more rounds there buy four more measurements of a room that cannot be improved. The lane taught measurement well and we are saturated on measurement — 22 image instruments, 94 guards, 2,659 tests. What is missing is production, and that lane cannot teach it.
trn002.condition: CLOSING IS NOT DISCHARGING. ~248 accepted-and-unbuilt critic items is uncomfortably close to the declared_gaps channel that grew 0 -> 28. So the top-20 recurrence rows (faceting 26/28 answer files, cloth stiffness 28/28, flat light 26/28) DO NOT close with the unit — they cross into DELIV-001 as debt rows with due_round, in the lane that can actually build them. P0d seeds the ledger from them by name.
